key_highlights: ASX sheds $90b in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressure miners and banks
Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase, hitting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX materially
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil explodes as OPEC+ suppression fails, lifting fuel prices 30c
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
ANZ.AX announces 3,500 job cuts; broader banking sector under structural pressure
Housing prices crash with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Fed rate-hike odds surge to 90% on core inflation jump, pressuring global risk assets
Australia softens local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears (Santos/SGS impact)
Superannuation reform debate intensifies with populist pressure vs. institutional concerns

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners lead the $90b weekly decline. Cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led mining dash). Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Diversified miners with copper/gold exposure (e.g., BHP.AX) less vulnerable. Small-cap explorers (Kuniko, Critical Resources) offer speculative upside but elevated dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. ANZ.AX cuts 3,500 jobs in structural cost programme. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressure NIMs but raise default risk. RBA rental inflation concern complicates policy.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from rate uncertainty. Housing price crash raises NPL concerns. Defensive dividend yield remains attractive but capital return sustainability questioned.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australian fuel prices to rise 30c. Australia softens local gas supply rules, supporting Santos (STO.AX) and gas producers. LNG export flexibility eases Asian fears.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, AGL.AX benefit from oil/gas price surge. Fuel cost pass-through pressures consumer staples. Energy sector is relative outperformer in risk-off tape.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) caught increasing 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promo, damaging brand trust. Housing crash boosts first-home buyer activity but broader consumer confidence weak.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs and promotional discipline. Housing-linked retailers (REA.AX, LPX.AX) may see transaction volume support from buyer surge.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. CSL.AX, SGH.AX provide defensive ballast. AI development slowdown calls from tech execs create uncertainty for ASX tech names. Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) shows procedure resilience.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, XRO.AX remain portfolio anchors. ASX-listed tech (IFL.AX, W1.AX) face sentiment headwind from global AI caution.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing price crash and no auction spring bounce signal prolonged correction. RBA rental inflation concern suggests tight supply but falling prices create mixed signals.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICQ.AX) face valuation pressure. Residential REITs most exposed; office/industrial less so. First-home buyer surge may support long-term absorption.

key_themes: Global rate-hike repricing (Fed 90% odds) driving risk-off across ASX
Iron ore structural demand concern (China) triggering commodity sell-off
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure
Housing market correction: prices falling, buyer activity rising
Superannuation reform debate: populist pressure vs. system integrity
Energy supply flexibility (gas rules) as geopolitical hedge
Corporate cost-cutting cycle (ANZ 3,500 jobs) signalling structural adjustment
Mining cap-raise wave indicating capital scarcity and project stress

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global rate-hike repricing / Fed policy shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration credit and equities with pricing power. Hedge AUD/USD via energy or export-oriented names.
Underweight pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX, RIO.AX); rotate to gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper-exposed names. Monitor Chinese PMI and property data.
Hedge via domestic-revenue companies (WES.AX, CSL.AX). Avoid high-import-cost sectors. Monitor RBA response to rental inflation.
Monitor bank NPL trends (CBA.AX, NAB.AX). Avoid leveraged residential REITs. First-home buyer surge may stabilise volumes.
Energy names (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as hedge. Monitor Yemen conflict and Arctic shipping routes.
Monitor legislative changes to contribution caps, access rules. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face policy uncertainty.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector on oil/gas price surge and gas supply rule easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explosion' and 30c fuel price rise support upstream margins; gas rule flexibility de-risks Asian export concerns

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and defensive healthcare as risk-off hedges
opportunities.rationale: AUD weakness and rate uncertainty support gold; CSL/SGH provide earnings visibility amid macro volatility

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on cap-raise momentum
opportunities.rationale: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing relative strength; Canaccord-led cap raises signal project advancement

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore and high-beta miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; $90b ASX loss concentrated in materials; China demand risk unresolved

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim residential REITs and housing-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing price crash, no auction bounce, and NPL risk to banks create downside for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce foreign-currency exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import inflation risk rising; 90% Fed hike odds pressure global liquidity

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as iron ore weakness, AUD depreciation, and global rate-hike repricing persist. Energy sector outperforms. Expect volatility around RBA commentary on rental inflation and any further commodity shocks. 10-year bond yield trajectory is the key swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise within 6-12 months as first-home buyer surge absorbs supply. Energy transition (battery tech, gas flexibility) supports structural themes. Superannuation system remains a long-term wealth engine despite reform noise. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus.
key_catalysts: RBA statement on rental inflation and rate path
Iron ore price floor and Chinese property stimulus signals
OPEC+ production decision and oil price sustainability
ANZ and peer bank NPL / cost-outcome data
US core CPI follow-through and Fed September decision
watch_list: Brent crude – suppression failure / 30c fuel pass-through
ASX cap-raise volume (mining sector stress indicator)
Housing auction clearance rates (no spring bounce confirmed)
